title: The Great Salmon Heist
staging:
Scene 21 — The Great Salmon Heist

17:45–18:30 · 45 sec · Factory interior

Ghost bypasses the security system. Onyx holds off pursuing guards. Neon and Byte access the shipping controls while Trixie discovers an enormous refrigerated salmon stockpile.

Shots: Stealth entry → massive salmon tanks → guard confrontation → hacking terminal → enormous warehouse reveal.
